name: Callum's cottage

objects.text: Comics and boxed retro games, alphabetical. A binder on top says DO NOT TOUCH (IN ORDER).
A whole shelf of Patchling pins. Callum calls it a collection. Everyone else calls it a problem.
A CRT running an emulator, paused mid-boss. The save file is older than the world.
The arcade cabinet from the porch, brought in out of the rain. It's always raining. It's a Scottish house.
Callum's bed. A handheld under the pillow, still on.
A McDonald's bag. Double cheeseburger, extra patty, extra cheese. The Triple Cheese. Again.
A kettle and a Scottish flag tea towel. His mum posted it. Into a video game. Somehow.
